question: Which of the following Indian states hosted the 2023 Hornbill Music Festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Hornbill Festival is celebrated in the state of **Nagaland**.
 
• Nagaland** ****hosted the 2023 Hornbill Music Festival**
 
• It is** named after the Indian Hornbill, a l**arge and colorful forest bird which is displayed in the folklore of most of the state's tribes.
 
• The festival **is held every year in the first week of December.**
 
• **The festival aims to revive and protect the rich culture of Nagaland a**nd display its extravaganza and traditions.
 
• It is also known as the 'Festival of Festivals' and is organized by the State Tourism and Art & Culture Departments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Nagaland is a state in Northeast India.
 
• The capital of Nagaland is Kohima, and its largest city is Dimapur.
 
• The state is known for its indigenous tribes, each with distinct festivals, customs, and traditions.
 
• The Hornbill Festival provides a unique opportunity to experience the customs, songs, dances, and food of Nagaland.
 
• The festival also includes various events such as traditional Naga Morungs exhibition, sale of arts and crafts, food stalls, herbal medicine stalls, fashion shows, beauty contest, traditional archery, Naga wrestling, and musical concerts.
